items.title: Optimizing PySpark UDFs on AWS Glue 6.0 with native Arrow UDFs
items.summary: Python UDFs in PySpark can be slow because data is serialized between the JVM and the Python runtime. We benchmark five approaches on AWS Glue 6.0 (standard Python, Arrow-optimized Python, vectorized pandas, native Arrow UDFs, and Spark SQL) across 10M to 100M rows, and separate transport cost from compute cost to explain the ranking.
items.creator: Iván Fernández Perea
